description.text: Duncan is an energetic, friendly city with a proven track record of business success, especially in the energy sector. The primary industry is manufacturing, including many national and international companies, which utilize our highly skilled workforce of machinist, welders, and engineers. Due to our workforce culture, the Duncan Area is ready for business in any industry.
